name: escalate
description: Record a callback request for a person. Works before or after verification. Call when the caller accepts a callback after a lockout, a tool failure, or a request outside your tools. After it returns, say the fixed goodbye sentence and call end_call.

request_body_schema.description: Tool request body. conversation_id and caller_id are filled by the system, never by the model.

reason.description: One sentence, at most 300 characters, saying why a person is needed. Never include digits, a PIN, or the caller's phone number.
